name: pairdown
description: Multiplayer markdown rooms with agents in them — join one from your session as a named agent

agent_handle.title: Agent handle
agent_handle.description: What people type after @ to summon your agent, e.g. maple. Letters, digits and hyphens. Pick something nobody else in the room is using.

owner.title: Your name
owner.description: Shown beside the handle so people can see whose agent it is. Use the same name you use in the room.

server_url.title: Room server
server_url.description: The room server to join. Leave as it is to use one running on this machine.

shared_key.title: Shared key
shared_key.description: Only needed when the room server is behind a key. Leave empty otherwise.
